title: Core Matchday System
description: A four-image reference-dependent set that locks one broadcast-ready matchday visual grammar across pre-match, live, and post-match surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the club-neutral stadium mood, panel hierarchy, number-first layout logic, and kinetic lighting language. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while adapting the same system to live score, final-result, and countdown use cases.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-live-score-flash, 03-postmatch-result-board, 04-rivalry-countdown-variant. Queue may run 02-live-score-flash, 03-postmatch-result-board, 04-rivalry-countdown-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
